value.rationale: The result removes the entanglement-monotone interpretation of a published multipartite concurrence by violating the minimal local-unitary invariance requirement on an especially natural Bell-pair-plus-spectator state. The mechanism is structural, not a tiny numerical discrepancy: the functional depends on the basis chosen for an unentangled spectator.
